scope: EAS CLI top-level and signer-info error reporting

behavior.command_failure: Top-level attestation command failures print a fixed operation label and bounded exception class before exiting nonzero.
behavior.signer_info: Best-effort attester status reports an unavailable class summary without echoing signer or RPC diagnostics.

coverage: top-level command failure omits provider details and exits with status 1
best-effort signer status omits raw exception and synthetic key marker
SAFE proposal error storage/return behavior remains covered
direct EAS signer result behavior remains covered

static_checks.database_or_provider_access: none; fake modules and mocked SAFE proposal boundary

limitations: No live attester key, EAS chain, SAFE service, or database was used.
This does not establish provider login, transaction proposal, or on-chain acceptance.
